semanticRules: All assets are preview-only NON-APPROVED concepts with FICTIONAL DATA; no application UI change is approved by this exploration.
One coherent visualization per image. Integrated table sparklines are cells within one visualization.
The JSON fixture and prompt specify semantics. Raster geometry is approximate; implementation computes coordinates/areas/counts from fixtures.
Native ratings are0.5–5 in half-star steps. Agreement subscores are0–100; insufficient evidence is unknown, never zero.
Actual taste weights: ratings40%, genres30%, reactions20%, interests10%, renormalized across qualified signals. Do not invent alternative weights.
Rating agreement uses mean absolute paired half-star difference divided by4.5; genres use cosine frequency vectors; reactions exact shared-emoji matches; interests saved-set Jaccard.
Each profile/pair needs the actual minimum evidence for a signal, currently at least5 relevant titles/shared pairs. Evidence sizes are not score denominators unless explicitly specified.
Time plots exclude unknown watch dates; state timezone and period. A journal timestamp is not playback duration. Release dates are separate metadata.
Probe comparisons require equivalent workload/dataset and no confounding background activity; fictional previews are not measured performance results.
Keep ms, MiB and counts separate. Radar axes use one common unit/domain or explicitly normalized score dimensions.
Pie/treemap/stacked values must be disjoint and additive. Unique people across months/cohorts are not automatically additive.
Progress/capacity and funnel plots disclose denominators/cohorts. Prefer observed baselines over arbitrary media viewing goals.
Medium colours remain consistent per legend; Music coral, Games mint, Screen lavender in cross-medium bubble concepts.
Bubble area is proportional to value; radius is sqrt(value). Isotype count is exact, with inactive filler only for real declared capacity.

Segmented preview datasets should follow the app medium semantics: movie watches/ratings, show episode watches/availability, game saves/plays/ratings, music album/listen/rating fixtures. Do not relabel episodes as games/albums.

Some auxiliary concepts use fictional viewer cohorts, instrumentation phases, release schedules or historical snapshots not established as current backend fields. Keep fixtures local to the preview and avoid implying available production data.
